name: Encoder
title: Encoder
subtitle: Kerbal Controller Mk1 · Encoder board
revisions: Supersedes the V2.0 drawings; redrawn in the KC drawing frame

rows.label: Encoder with A/B pull-ups, RC filters and push-switch pull-down (SW1)

layers.name: Top Layer
notes: The encoder (SW1) solders to this side.

layers.name: Bottom Layer
notes: Component side: the resistors, capacitors and header H1.

fab_notes: 1. Material: FR-4, 1.6 mm, 2 layers, JLCPCB standard (sheet 1 table).
2. Copper: 1 oz both sides. Surface finish: lead-free HASL.
3. Solder mask green, silkscreen white, both sides. Vias tented.
4. Fabricate to IPC-6012 Class 2. Electrical test 100 %.
5. Dimensions in mm. Tolerances unless noted: outline ±0.2, finished holes ±0.08.
6. Fabricate from the Gerber and drill files of the same revision as this drawing.
7. Minimum trace width 0.20 mm. Smallest hole Ø0.30 (vias) on Ø0.61 pads: 0.15 mm annular ring.
8. Two plated slots 1.80 × 2.80 mm for the encoder mounting tabs, routed and plated.
9. No mounting holes; the board hangs from the encoder. No controlled impedance, castellations, edge plating or gold fingers.
bom_notes: 1. INSTALLED BY: JLCPCB = fitted by the JLCPCB assemblers (SMT and through-hole) before delivery; After delivery = fitted by the builder.
2. PROCESS gives the assembly process and the side the part is on.
3. The knob is fitted in the next assembly.
4. Substitutes need the approval of the design authority.
place_notes: 1. The encoder SW1 is on the top side; the resistors, capacitors and header H1 are on the bottom side.
2. The bottom view is drawn as seen holding the board bottom side up (flipped left to right), so the datum is at the top right.
3. Red dot = pin 1 of every part with more than two pins (SW1, H1). These match the silkscreen marks.
4. Part centres, rotations and part numbers are in the placement table (last sheet), measured from the datum (top view).
